Maria: Quick weekly check-in for Nimbus — flagged some throughput & spend changes. WoW tokens +28%, QoQ +12%. 95p latency up to 420ms (vs 350ms last week), error rate 0.6% (spike in 429s), total spend +23% MoM. Onboarding progress 80% (sandbox -> prod planned). Renewal risk low but need to slow spend growth. @Leo @Anita please weigh in. :eyes:
Leo: Looking now — can you paste top 3 routes by token volume?
Maria: Top routes this week (query from dash):
```
/compose - 54% tokens
/summarize - 18% tokens
/search-assist - 12% tokens
other - 16%
```
Leo: thx — most of the /compose traffic is short-chained sessions with no caching. Error breakdown: 429s ~ 75% of errors, 500s remaining. I'll push a burst-policy tweak and enable prefix cache for /compose. ETA tomorrow.
Anita: Onboarding + enablement: scheduled pro-training with customer 4/2, doc updates live, two support tickets open for prompt templates. Renewal touchpoint scheduled for next Wed. Low exec risk but ops ask for guidance on rate limits.
InfraBot: autoscaler: added 2x pods to nimbus-prod @2721115200 due to 95p latency > 400ms threshold. CPU nodes: 72%.
Sam: Dash snapshot: https://redwood.app/d/abcd123/nimbus — QoQ token curve attached. Recommendation: enable KV prefix caching + increase short-window burst cap to reduce 429s; estimated cost savings 12-15% vs current spend trajectory.
Maria: Action items: 1) Leo enable prefix cache + burst policy tweak (owner @Leo, due Thu). 2) Anita run enablement playbook and confirm docs (owner @Anita, due Fri). 3) Sam share cost-forecast with finance (owner @Sam, due Fri). I'll follow up after changes. :thumbsup:
Leo: on it.
Anita: noted.
Sam: I'll export forecast and ping finance.
Maria: Thanks team — will mark as done once we see 95p < 380ms and 429s < 0.2% WoW. Closing interim check next Tue.
